ieee.csl.xml is the IEEE Citation Style Language style maintained by the Citation Style Language
project and its listed contributors.

Source: https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/ieee.csl

The file is redistributed unchanged. Its full contributor list and licence declaration are inside
the CSL file.
